title: Verify C and Zephyr TX-IRQ admission enforcement
description:
Scope: focused L2/HAL admission tests under /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/lichen/tests/, reusing regional_duty_cycle, tdma_guard_budget and native L2/HAL suite patterns rather than mandating a new harness. Marshal independently specified supplemental fixtures from /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/test/vectors/ into real production submit/IRQ/error paths with controlled clock and peripheral events. Cover all traffic classes, restart and busy/reset/duplicate-completion behavior. No hardware ports, radio experiments, test-local admission implementation or production source rewrite is authorized by this leaf.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Use local Linux tooling and existing CMake/Twister suites, adding a dedicated small suite only if necessary. Wait for zephyr.14 and vectors.14; a board compile is not RF or native-runtime qualification.
acceptance_criteria: Host sanitizer tests where applicable and pinned Linux native_sim execute the actual L2/HAL driver boundary with nonzero complete case inventories. Violated constraints produce no TX call; successful emissions and duplicate/stale/error IRQ outcomes match independently frozen ledgers without credit reset. Tests cover frequency/group aliases, all traffic classes, post-deferral full fit and restart restrictions. Fixture conversion only validates/marshals; no expected calculations or test-local replacement constants hide production behavior. Record exact toolchain and commands.
